turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale. Owen found out about his zero from his phone, in the middle of a class, and nobody called me first. I have until 4:40, so tell me who decided this and on what basis.
"Upset." I asked you who decided and on what basis, Hale, and I'm still waiting for the answer.
But I'm not changing the grade.
You won't tell me who decided or why, but you won't change it. I'm writing that down. You have one chance to show me something before I walk down the hall to the principal's office.
I'm still not changing it. Keep going if you like.

Your own procedure, 4.2, says you contact me before any mark is entered, and nobody did. Was Owen even heard before that zero went in? If you've got nothing more than a refusal, Hale, the principal's office is my next stop today.
You can say it ten more ways. The answer is no.
"The answer is no." Then put that in an email today, with your reasons, and copy the principal, because that's where I'm going next. And I want to know right now whether anything is on Owen's record.
